entries.name: John Cluchette

expected.charges: Murder of Soledad guard John Mills (Soledad Brothers prosecution)
expected.sentence:
Acquitted by jury after more than two years held in pretrial custody at San Quentin

Verdict as recorded: No — acquitted by California state jury on March 27, 1972

updates.sentence: Acquittal did not end his imprisonment on the earlier burglary conviction. The parole board subsequently set a November 13, 1972 parole date; the precise physical-release date has not been independently verified.

entries.rationale: Duplicate spelling record individually matched by Soledad Brothers co-defendants George Jackson and Fleeta Drumgo, victim John Mills, and March 27, 1972 acquittal. Same court chronology applies. March 26 release contradicts continuing original sentence; remove it. No profile merge or biographical edits; exact initial case arrest day not resolved.
